spans.s:
(औ) दिशौ r. 6th cl. (दिशति-ते)
1 To show, to exhibit, to explain or make intelligible.
2 To order, to command, to direct or send.
3 To say, to speak.
4 To give.
With अप prefixed,
To change, to disguise.
With आङ्,
1 To order or command.
2 To show.
3 To summons.
With उद्,
1 To proclaim, to make known or public.
2 To show.
With उप,
To point out (literally or metaphorically), to show, to advise.
With निर्,
1 To speak aloud.
2 To specify, to show.
With प्र,
To appoint, to order.
With प्रति and सम्,
To command, to return, to send back.
With वि and अप,
To plead in excuse, to state as a plea or pretext.
With वि and निर्,
To declare.
With सम्,
1 To exhibit, to show, &c.
2 To communicate as news or information.
With सम् and आङ्,
To approve, to permit.
With सम and उप,
To point out at a distance, as with the finger.

f. (-दिक्-दिशौ-दिशः)
Region, space, quarter, part.
E.
दिश to shew, affix क्विन्; also with टाप् added, दिशा, f. (-शा) or with ङीप्, द्रिशी.

f. (-शाः)
Region, quarter.
E.
दिश, and असुन् affix: see the preceding.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Situated, bearing, lying in a particular tract or quarter, as पर्व्वदिश्य eastern, bearing east.
E.
दिश् a quarter, यत् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Shown, pointed out.
2 Delineated, described.
3 Counselled, advised, enjoined.
m. (-ष्टः)
1

A sort of Curcuma: see दारुहरिद्रा.
n. (-ष्टं)
Fate, destiny, fortune, good or ill luck.
E.
दिश् to show, affix क्त.

m. (-न्तः)
Death, dying.
E.
दिष्ट fortune, and अन्त end.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Pleasure, happiness.
2 A sort of measure.
E.
दिश् to point out, affix क्तिन्.

ind.
An exclamation, indicative of joy or auspiciousness, luckily, fortunately.
E.
दिश् pointing out, स्त्यै to sound, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Giving, one who gives, a donor.
E.
दा to give, इष्णु Uṇādi affix: see देष्णु.
